rules: 1. conductsResearch(X, Y) :- advisesStudent(X, Z), conductsResearch(Z, Y)
2. conductsResearch(X, Y) :- isColleagueOf(X, Z), conductsResearch(Z, Y)
3. conductsResearch(X, Y) :- hasCollaborationWith(X, Z), conductsResearch(Z, Y)
4. conductsResearch(X, Y) :- worksAtInstitute(X, Z), conductsResearch(Z, Y)
5. conductsResearch(X, Y) :- receivedGrant(X, Z), focusesOnResearch(Z, Y)
